cohort: The study included 27 small for gestational age (SGA) newborns and 21 appropriate for gestational age (AGA) neonates, born to mothers with preeclampsia/hypertension or physiological pregnancies.
finding: Small for gestational age newborns and those born to preeclamptic or hypertensive mothers had significantly higher umbilical cord MDA and NGAL levels compared to appropriate for gestational age newborns and those born to healthy mothers.
cross-section timing: Umbilical blood collection and blood samples 12 hours after delivery
